item.text:
Refactored the sorting pipeline so it no longer passes raw `List<Integer>` around as the public result. [TopologicalSort.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalSort.java:1) and [TopologicalSorter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalSorter.java:1) now return a dedicated [TopologicalOrder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalOrder.java:5) value object, which makes the API more explicit and keeps immutability at the boundary.

I also extracted Kahn traversal bookkeeping into [TraversalState.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TraversalState.java:6). That leaves [KahnTopologicalSorter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/KahnTopologicalSorter.java:4) focused on the algorithm flow instead of mixing queue management, indegree mutation, and result accumulation in one method. The demo and formatter were updated accordingly in [TopologicalSortDemo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalSortDemo.java:5) and [TopologicalOrderFormatter.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/006_topological_sorting_bfs/TopologicalOrderFormatter.java:3).

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeded, and `java TopologicalSortDemo` still prints `0 4 5 1 2 3`.
